title: Occupancy Modeling via Drifting: One-Step Generation Enables Direct Policy Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2610.19883v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The growing interest in behavior foundation models, combined with recent advancements in generative modeling, has led to an appealing recipe for reinforcement learning from unlabeled data: pre-train a generative model to model occupancies, i.e., discounted state visitations, on reward-free trajectories, such that a policy can be easily extracted once a small reward-labeled dataset becomes available. We decompose this recipe along three axes: (i) the degree to which the multi-modal structure of occupancies must be captured, (ii) the class of generative model, and (iii) the method used for policy extraction. Along each axis, we consider existing choices, propose simpler alternatives, and validate each decision experimentally. This analysis culminates in a novel, streamlined method that leverages drifting, a modern one-step generative sampler, to model the occupancy. translated_title: 基于漂移的占用度建模：单步生成实现直接策略提取
translated_abstract: 对行为基础模型日益增长的兴趣，结合生成式建模的最新进展，催生了一种从无标注数据中进行强化学习的诱人方案：预训练一个生成式模型来建模占用度（即在无奖励轨迹上的折扣状态访问分布），这样一旦获得一个小的带奖励标注的数据集，就可以轻松地提取策略。我们沿着三个维度对该方案进行分解：(i) 需要在多大程度上捕捉占用度的多模态结构，(ii) 生成式模型的类别，以及 (iii) 用于策略提取的方法。在每一个维度上，我们分析了现有选择、提出了更简单的替代方案，并通过实验验证了每项决策。这一分析最终形成了一种新颖且精简的方法，该方法利用漂移——一种现代的单步生成采样器——来建模占用度。我们证明这使得可以通过对学习到的模型进行直接微分来实现策略提取……
tldr: 该论文提出使用现代单步生成采样器“漂移”来建模占用度，从而通过直接微分即可从生成模型中提取策略，显著简化了从无标注数据进行强化学习的流程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using "drifting", a modern one-step generative sampler, to model occupancies, enabling direct policy extraction via differentiation and streamlining reinforcement learning from unlabeled data.
